notes.title: STREET DREAMS - OUT NOW
notes.content:

[h1]It's release day! 🎉🥳 [/h1]
[h3]To celebrate, Street Dreams will have a 30% launch-week discount![/h3]

[b]Get ahead of the competition - earn your place at the top of the leaderboards![/b]

[b]After months of development, I'm super excited to finally be releasing Street Dreams! If you have any feedback at all - [i]bugs, gameplay improvements, what you love/hate[/i] - please let me know on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/AnthonySturdy]@AnthonySturdy[/url].[/b]

[b]- Anthony[/b]
